about.title: About
about.p1: I'm Gustavo Balula, a full-stack developer with about 2 years of professional experience. I currently work at GG Checkout — a white-label SaaS platform processing payments via PIX, cards and crypto for digital product sellers.
about.p2: Day-to-day I architect and implement integrations with payment gateways using patterns like Factory and Abstract Class, while building complete features such as upsell/downsell funnels, Store Builder, members area and multi-channel notification systems via the WhatsApp Business API.
about.p3: Studying Systems Analysis and Development (Cruzeiro do Sul Virtual, in progress). Advanced English. Insatiable curiosity for distributed systems, observability and the intersection of design systems and developer experience.
